narrator
text: Kanpur. Hostel Block C, Room 214. The warden wants it back by Monday.

speaker: new_kid
text: Internship letter from Gurugram! Stipend: ₹8,000. Accommodation: *"figure it out"*.

speaker: narrator
text: Meet *Bablu*. 21. B.Tech, third year. Four backlogs. One suitcase. Zero references.

speaker: narrator
text: Delhi NCR. Population: yes. Air quality: also yes.

speaker: new_kid
text: Every society gate has the same board. *NO BACHELORS*. Some add *NO NON-VEG*. One just says *NO*.

speaker: narrator
text: RWA rule: no bachelor rents anything without *police verification*, stamped at the *Sarkari Daftar*.

speaker: new_kid
text: Internship starts in *11 days*. One flat, one stamp, 11 days. How hard can it be?

speaker: narrator
text: In NCR everything is temporary. Except the rules for bachelors.

speaker: pinky_aunty
text: A *bachelor*? At MY gate? I am Pinky. RWA WhatsApp admin. I wrote that board myself.

speaker: new_kid
text: Aunty, I am just an engineering student. I need a room for my internship—

speaker: pinky_aunty
text: *Engineer?!* Beta, my WiFi is not working since Diwali. Also the TV says "No Signal". Also my phone is full.

speaker: new_kid
text: (turns it off and on again)

speaker: pinky_aunty
text: WAH. Genius. Okay, I will help you. You are like my son. Who is in Canada. And never calls.

speaker: pinky_aunty
text: But first, forward this to 10 people. Sharma ji didn't forward, and now his flat has *seepage*.

speaker: narrator
text: *Rajiv Chowk* metro. 6 PM. Bablu has a flat viewing at 6:30.

speaker: new_kid
text: Excuse me, my stop is next, can I just—

speaker: jaanu
text: *Bro.* Can't you see we're having a *moment*?

speaker: shona
text: Babe, he's staring. Babe. *BABE.* Do something.

speaker: narrator
text: The doors are blocked. The viewing is in 30 minutes. There is only one way out.

speaker: broker
text: Sir! Sir! Welcome welcome. Very nice flat, sir. East-facing. Vastu-compliant. Metro walking distance.

speaker: new_kid
text: The metro is 4 km away. Also, I am a bachelor.

speaker: broker
text: No problem, sir! For bachelors, rent is double and brokerage is triple. Walking distance for a fit person.

speaker: broker
text: One month brokerage. One month deposit. One month "documentation". One month "my cousin's wedding".

speaker: new_kid
text: That's four months! I get ₹8,000 a month!

speaker: broker
text: Sir, the owner is *very nice*. Very nice. Let's settle this the Delhi way.

speaker: broker
text: Okay okay! Sir, half brokerage. Final. Okay, quarter. Okay, I'll throw in a free... *temporary address proof*.

speaker: new_kid
text: Is it valid?

speaker: broker
text: Valid for 11 months, sir. Like everything.

speaker: ceo
text: Bablu! My new intern! Welcome to *Walkr*. We're disrupting walking.

speaker: new_kid
text: Sir, about the stipend—

speaker: ceo
text: We pay in *equity*. And exposure. And cold coffee on alternate Fridays.

speaker: ceo
text: Your first task: our *culture-fit round*. It's a fight. Strategic, scalable violence.

speaker: ceo
text: Okay so. Personal news. After an incredible journey, Walkr is *shutting down*.

speaker: new_kid
text: My internship hasn't even started. Do I still have it?

speaker: ceo
text: Sure! Unpaid. Remote. From your flat. You do have a flat, right?

speaker: ceo
text: Great talk. I'll post about you on LinkedIn. "Humbled to have mentored a fighter."

speaker: babu
text: Hmm.

speaker: new_kid
text: Sir, *police verification*. For a rent agreement. Just one stamp.

speaker: babu
text: Bachelor?

speaker: new_kid
text: ...Yes.

speaker: babu
text: Bachelor verification is a different window. *Window 7*. Window 7 is closed since 2009.

speaker: babu
text: Original, three photocopies, self-attested, attested by gazetted officer... and your *soul*. Come. Let us begin the procedure.

speaker: babu
text: ...Fine. Stamped. Now go.

speaker: new_kid
text: *POLICE VERIFICATION: VALID FOR 11 MONTHS*. Pinky Aunty! I got it!

speaker: pinky_aunty
text: Beta, wonderful! But the RWA had an emergency meeting. New rule: *no bachelors under 30*.

speaker: new_kid
text: I am 21.

speaker: narrator
text: Your phone buzzes. *Delivery Wale Bhaiya*: "Sir, 2 minute."

speaker: new_kid
text: ...I love this city.

speaker: narrator
text: Everything is temporary. Except Delhi.
